title: P1/P2/P3/P4 is the canonical priority scale for WAI lugs
description: Replaced ad-hoc priority values (high, critical, medium, low, session_focus, before_next_epic, verbose P-labels) with a clean 4-level scale: P1=high/critical, P2=medium, P3=low, P4=trivial. Workflow qualifiers (session_focus, before_next_epic) are not priorities — they belong in workflow_flag. Migration: old values remain readable (dual-read), new lugs must use P1–P4.
rationale: 70+ lugs used 'high', 13 used 'critical', 8 others used various non-standard values. The inconsistency made priority sorting unreliable. The 4-level scale is machine-sortable and human-obvious.
